<!doctype html>
<html lang="ro">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#F3EDE1">
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,">
<style>:root{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]{display:none!important}</style>
</head>
<body>
<title>Noot</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Noot">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;800&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: phone-first single column, fixed bottom tab bar, cards only for separate objects */
:root{
  --h:240; /* fixed palette: crem Lumière, lavandă-albastră, indigo — from the three samples */
  --bg:hsl(40 52% 92%);         /* crem Lumière RMDV06 */
  --surface:hsl(40 55% 96%);
  --surface2:hsl(40 36% 86%);
  --fg:hsl(228 30% 30%);        /* indigo — text (puțin mai închis decât mostra, pentru citit) */
  --muted:hsl(228 14% 46%);
  --line:hsl(40 28% 80%);
  --accent:hsl(240 24% 56%);    /* lavandă-albastră, exact mostra */
  --accent-soft:hsl(240 26% 88%);
  --accent-fg:#fff;
  --cal:hsl(228 22% 45%);       /* indigo (mostra) — calendar */
  --cal-soft:hsl(228 24% 88%);
  --cal-fg:#fff;
  --work:hsl(176 55% 40%);      /* doar în grafice: Muncă (turcoaz), contrast total cu indigo */
  --good:hsl(228 22% 45%);
  --warn:hsl(240 24% 56%);
  --cream:hsl(38 45% 96%);
  --display:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif;
  --body:"Nunito",system-ui,sans-serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:hsl(228 22% 10%);--surface:hsl(228 18% 14%);--surface2:hsl(228 15% 19%);
  --fg:hsl(40 45% 91%);--muted:hsl(228 10% 68%);--line:hsl(228 12% 26%);
  --accent:hsl(240 30% 70%);--accent-soft:hsl(240 18% 25%);--accent-fg:hsl(228 22% 10%);
  --cal:hsl(228 30% 68%);--cal-soft:hsl(228 16% 23%);--cal-fg:hsl(228 22% 10%);--work:hsl(176 55% 55%);
  --good:hsl(228 30% 68%);--warn:hsl(240 30% 70%);color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:hsl(228 22% 10%);--surface:hsl(228 18% 14%);--surface2:hsl(228 15% 19%);
  --fg:hsl(40 45% 91%);--muted:hsl(228 10% 68%);--line:hsl(228 12% 26%);
  --accent:hsl(240 30% 70%);--accent-soft:hsl(240 18% 25%);--accent-fg:hsl(228 22% 10%);
  --cal:hsl(228 30% 68%);--cal-soft:hsl(228 16% 23%);--cal-fg:hsl(228 22% 10%);--work:hsl(176 55% 55%);
  --good:hsl(228 30% 68%);--warn:hsl(240 30% 70%);color-scheme:dark}
.hero{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:170px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:18px;color:#fff;background:#6b4a3a}
.hero svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.hero .in{position:relative;z-index:1;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.hero .in h1{color:#fff}.hero .in .eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.album{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px}
.album figure{margin:0;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.album img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.album figcaption{padding:6px 9px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.album .rm{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:26px;height:26px;font-weight:800}
.menu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.menu button{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 14px;text-align:left;font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.menu button span{font-weight:600;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
/* cheerful shell */
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.brand{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.brand i{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.stars{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--fg);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 11px;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem}
.avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}
.banner{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:880/370;max-width:100%;background:var(--surface2)}.banner img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.hero2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.hero2 .txt{flex:1;min-width:0}
.hero2 h1{font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1}
.hero2 .cup{width:128px;height:128px;flex:none;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface2);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -12px rgba(30,40,45,.45)}
.hero2 .cup img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 50%;display:block}
.motto{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--work);margin-top:8px;font-style:italic;font-family:var(--display);text-wrap:balance}
.streak{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem}
.week{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.week .days{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px;min-width:0}
.week .wd{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:8px 0;border-radius:14px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.4rem;position:relative;background:transparent}
.week .wd small{font-family:var(--body);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:capitalize}
.week .wd.today{background:var(--cal);color:var(--cal-fg)}
.week .wd.today small{color:var(--cal-fg);opacity:.85}
.week .wd .dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cal);margin-top:2px}
.week .wd.today .dot{background:var(--cal-fg)}
.week .arr{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.4rem;padding:6px}
.sec{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.sec .ico{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.6rem;flex:none;font-weight:900}
.sec .ico{color:var(--accent-fg);font-weight:900}.sec .ico.y{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg)}.sec .ico.p,.sec .ico.g,.sec .ico.b{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--accent)}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .sec .ico.y,:root[data-theme="dark"] .sec .ico.g,:root[data-theme="dark"] .sec .ico.b{background:var(--surface2)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .sec .ico.y,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .sec .ico.g,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .sec .ico.b{background:var(--surface2)}}
.sec .tt{flex:1;min-width:0}.sec .tt p{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pct{font-weight:800;color:var(--accent)}
.card.done{border-color:var(--accent);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface))}
.confetti{position:fixed;top:-10px;width:9px;height:14px;z-index:55;pointer-events:none;animation:drop 1.8s ease-in forwards;border-radius:2px}
@keyframes drop{to{transform:translateY(105vh) rotate(540deg);opacity:.8}}
.timesel{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.timesel select{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:14px 12px;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;min-height:54px;text-align:center}.timesel b{font-size:1.3rem}
/* priorities */
.task[data-list="personal"] .box{border-color:var(--cal)}.task[data-list="personal"][data-done="1"] .box{background:var(--cal);border-color:var(--cal)}
.task[data-list="work"] .box{border-color:var(--work)}.task[data-list="work"][data-done="1"] .box{background:var(--work);border-color:var(--work)}
.task .tag.pro{background:var(--work);color:#fff}.task .tag.pers{background:var(--cal);color:#fff}
.chip.lp[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--cal);background:var(--cal);color:#fff}.chip.lw[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--work);background:var(--work);color:#fff}
.card.lp{border-left:6px solid var(--cal)}.card.lw{border-left:6px solid var(--work)}
.pri{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;border:2.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent}
.pri[data-p="hi"]{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}.pri[data-p="mid"]{background:var(--cal);border-color:var(--cal)}.pri[data-p="normal"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--cal);opacity:.6}
.task[data-p="hi"] .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}.task[data-p="mid"] .t{color:var(--cal);font-weight:800}
.task[data-done="1"][data-p] .t{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.pbtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;background:var(--surface)}
.pbtn[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:currentColor;background:var(--surface2)}
.pbtn.hi{color:var(--accent)}.pbtn.mid{color:var(--cal)}.pbtn.normal{color:var(--fg)}
.sec .ico.r{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);font-weight:900;font-family:var(--body);font-size:2rem}
.pals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}@media(min-width:560px){.pals{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}}
.palb{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;background:var(--surface);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:left}
.palb[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--fg)}
.palb i{display:flex;height:34px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}.palb i b{flex:1}
.palb span{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted)}
.tiles.mv label.f{justify-content:flex-end;white-space:nowrap;font-size:.82rem}.tiles.mv input{width:100%}
html,body{height:100%}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;margin:0}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--bg)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;margin:0;text-wrap:balance;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h1{font-size:2rem}h2{font-size:1.35rem}h3{font-size:1.05rem}
p{margin:0}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;padding:0}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.app{min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
main{flex:1;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));padding-block:14px 96px;max-width:640px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
.view{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.eyebrow{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.between{justify-content:space-between}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);min-height:44px}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--fg)}
.btn.small{padding:7px 12px;min-height:34px;font-size:.88rem}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);font-weight:600;min-height:40px}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--fg)}
input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=date],input[type=time],select,textarea{width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface);min-height:44px}
textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
label.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);min-width:0;flex:1}
/* nav */
nav.tabs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--surface);border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:6px max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));z-index:20}
nav.tabs button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:12px;min-width:52px}
nav.tabs button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
nav.tabs svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* routine */
.task{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.task:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.task .box{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;border:2.5px solid var(--accent);flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all .2s;font-weight:900;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--accent-fg)}
.task[data-done="1"] .box{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg)}
.task[data-done="1"] .t{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--muted)}
.task .t{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:600}
.task .tag{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.task .del{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.2rem;padding:4px 6px}
.mic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.mic[data-on="1"]{animation:pulse 1s infinite;background:var(--warn)}
.mic svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.12)}}
.hint{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.progress{height:10px;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
.progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:999px;transition:width .4s}
/* rewards */
/* rewards: discreet, adult */
.ripple{position:fixed;width:34px;height:34px;margin:-17px 0 0 -17px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent);pointer-events:none;z-index:50;animation:ring .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(3.2);opacity:0}}
.fw{position:fixed;width:20px;height:20px;margin:-10px 0 0 -10px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--accent);pointer-events:none;z-index:55;animation:fwring 1.2s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes fwring{0%{transform:scale(.3);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(9);opacity:0}}
.spark{position:fixed;width:6px;height:6px;margin:-3px 0 0 -3px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:55;animation:spark 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes spark{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(var(--dx),calc(var(--dy) + 40px)) scale(.3);opacity:0}}
.progress i{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--accent)}.progress i.glow{animation:glow .9s ease-out}
@keyframes glow{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--accent)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 18px 2px transparent}}
.burst{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:50;font-size:20px;color:var(--accent);animation:fly 1.1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes fly{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.6);opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(1.3);opacity:0}}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;z-index:60;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
.toast.on{opacity:1}
/* calendar */
.cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px}
.cal .dow{text-align:center;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.cal .d{aspect-ratio:1;max-width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;position:relative;width:100%;background:var(--surface)}
.cal .d.pad{opacity:0}
.cal .d.today{outline:2px solid var(--cal);outline-offset:-2px}
.cal .d.sel{background:var(--cal);color:var(--cal-fg)}
.cal .d .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cal);position:absolute;bottom:5px}
.cal .d.sel .dot{background:var(--cal-fg)}
.cal .d.per{background:var(--cal-soft);color:var(--cal)}
.cal .d.pred{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--cal)}
.ev{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ev:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.ev .time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800;color:var(--cal);min-width:88px;font-size:.9rem}
.ev .tt{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:600}
/* charts */
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:120px;padding-top:8px}
.bars .b{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:100%;justify-content:flex-end}
.bars .b i{display:block;width:100%;max-width:28px;border-radius:6px 6px 2px 2px;background:var(--work);min-height:0}
.bars .b i.me{background:var(--cal)}
.bars .b i.zero{display:none}
.bars .b span{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}
.big{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.2rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:10px}
.tile{background:var(--surface2);border-radius:14px;padding:12px}
.tile .eyebrow{margin-bottom:4px}
/* project */
.kan{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
@media(min-width:560px){.kan{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}}
.kan .col{background:var(--surface2);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.kan .item{background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
.kan .item span{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.kan .item button{color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem}
/* quiz */
.opt{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);font-weight:600;margin-top:8px}
.opt.ok{border-color:var(--good);background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--good) 18%,var(--surface))}
.opt.bad{border-color:var(--warn);background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--warn) 18%,var(--surface))}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent}
.sw[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--fg)}
/* onboarding */
.ob{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;padding-block:24px}
.ob .logo{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.ob .logo i{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.steps{display:flex;gap:5px}.steps i{flex:1;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--line)}.steps i.on{background:var(--accent)}
.q{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.counter{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:999px;padding:4px}
.counter button{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);font-weight:800}
.counter b{min-width:20px;text-align:center}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>

<div class="app">
<main id="main"></main>
<nav class="tabs" id="tabs" hidden>

<script>
/* ---------- state ---------- */
const KEY='notara.v1';
const todayKey=()=>{const d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')};
const defaults=()=>({
  profile:null, hue:240, pal:'lumiere', sound:true,
  routine:[], // {id,text,when:'dim'|'pranz'|'seara',cat:'eu'|'munca'}
  days:{},    // key -> {done:[ids], steps, km, sport, dayRating, mood, dream, note}
  events:[],  // {id,title,date:'YYYY-MM-DD',start:'HH:MM',end:'HH:MM',weekly:dow|null}
  period:[],  // ['YYYY-MM-DD']
  project:{name:'',ideas:[],tasks:[],done:[]},
  dream:'',
  scores:[],  // {lang,level,score,date}
  todos:{personal:[],work:[]}, // {id,text,done}
  photos:[],  // {id,src,caption,date}
  habits:[]   // {id,text} obiceiuri de lăsat
});
let S=defaults();
try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(raw)S=Object.assign(defaults(),JSON.parse(raw))}catch(e){}
if(S.profile){if(!S.routine.some(r=>/10 minute de AI/i.test(r.text)))S.routine.push({id:'ai10',text:'10 minute de AI (am învățat sau am folosit ceva nou)',when:'seara',cat:'munca'});S.routine.forEach(r=>{if(/^Am citit (câteva pagini|sau am învățat ceva nou)$/.test(r.text))r.text='30 de minute de citit'});if(!S.routine.some(r=>/minute de citit/i.test(r.text)))S.routine.push({id:'citit30',text:'30 de minute de citit',when:'seara',cat:'eu'})}
function save(){S.updatedAt=Date.now();try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}cloudSave()}
/* ---------- cloud sync (private, per account) ---------- */
const sync={doc:null,status:'local',timer:null,busy:false,dirty:false,applying:false};
function cloudSave(){if(!sync.doc||sync.applying)return;sync.dirty=true;clearTimeout(sync.timer);sync.timer=setTimeout(flush,1500)}
async function flush(){if(!sync.doc||sync.busy||!sync.dirty)return;sync.busy=true;sync.dirty=false;try{await sync.doc.set({state:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S)),updatedAt:S.updatedAt||Date.now()});sync.status='ok'}catch(e){sync.status='err';sync.dirty=true}sync.busy=false;if(sync.dirty)cloudSave()}
function applyRemote(data){if(!data||!data.state)return;if((data.updatedAt||0)<=(S.updatedAt||0))return;sync.applying=true;S=Object.assign(defaults(),data.state);try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}sync.applying=false;render()}
(async()=>{try{const u=window.claude&&window.claude.use?await window.claude.use('user'):null;if(!u)return;const id=await u.id();if(!id)return;const db=await window.claude.use('db');if(!db)return;
  sync.doc=db.doc('data/users/'+id+'/state');const snap=await sync.doc.get();sync.status='ok';
  if(snap.exists)applyRemote(snap.data());else if(S.profile){sync.dirty=true;flush()}
  sync.doc.onSnapshot(s=>{if(s.exists&&!s.metadata.hasPendingWrites)applyRemote(s.data())},e=>{sync.status='err'});
  if(view==='set')render()}catch(e){sync.status='err'}})();
const day=(k=todayKey())=>S.days[k]||(S.days[k]={done:[],steps:'',km:'',sport:'',dayRating:'',mood:'',dream:'',resist:[]});
const uid=()=>Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9);
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));

/* ---------- suggestions ---------- */
const SUG={
  f:[
    ['Am băut un pahar cu apă','dim','eu'],['M-am spălat pe dinți','dim','eu'],['Mi-am băut cafeaua în liniște','dim','eu'],['Skincare de dimineață','dim','eu'],['Mi-am aranjat părul','dim','eu'],['Mi-am ales hainele care îmi plac','dim','eu'],['Mi-am consultat agenda','dim','munca'],['Am ajuns la serviciu la timp','dim','munca'],
    ['Am mâncat sănătos la prânz','pranz','eu'],['Mi-am luat vitaminele','pranz','eu'],['Am făcut o pauză de 10 minute doar pentru mine','pranz','eu'],['Am rezolvat prioritatea zilei','pranz','munca'],
    ['Am făcut mișcare (plimbare, yoga, sală)','seara','eu'],['Skincare de seară','seara','eu'],['M-am spălat pe dinți','seara','eu'],['30 de minute de citit','seara','eu'],['Am pregătit ziua de mâine','seara','munca'],['10 minute de AI (am învățat sau am folosit ceva nou)','seara','munca'],['Am vorbit cu cineva drag','seara','eu'],['Fără telefon cu 30 min înainte de somn','seara','eu']
  ],
  m:[
    ['Am băut un pahar cu apă','dim','eu'],['M-am spălat pe dinți','dim','eu'],['M-am bărbierit / aranjat barba','dim','eu'],['Exerciții fizice de dimineață','dim','eu'],['Mi-am băut cafeaua','dim','eu'],['Mi-am ales ținuta','dim','eu'],['Mi-am consultat agenda','dim','munca'],['Am stabilit cele 3 priorități ale zilei','dim','munca'],
    ['Am mâncat sănătos la prânz','pranz','eu'],['Mi-am luat vitaminele','pranz','eu'],['Am rezolvat prioritatea zilei','pranz','munca'],['Am răspuns la mesajele importante','pranz','munca'],
    ['Antrenament / sport','seara','eu'],['M-am spălat pe dinți','seara','eu'],['30 de minute de citit','seara','eu'],['Am pregătit ziua de mâine','seara','munca'],['10 minute de AI (am învățat sau am folosit ceva nou)','seara','munca'],['Timp cu familia / prietenii','seara','eu'],['Fără ecrane cu 30 min înainte de somn','seara','eu']
  ]
};
const extraSug=p=>{const x=[];if(p.kids>0)x.push(['Timp de calitate cu copiii','seara','eu']);if(p.kids>0&&p.kidStage.includes('scoala'))x.push(['Am verificat temele / ghiozdanul','seara','eu']);if(p.pets.dog>0)x.push(['Plimbare cu câinele','dim','eu']);if(p.pets.cat>0)x.push(['Hrană și apă proaspătă pentru pisică','dim','eu']);if(p.rel==='casatorit'||p.rel==='relatie')x.push(['Un gest frumos pentru partener','seara','eu']);return x};

/* ---------- sound & rewards ---------- */
let AC=null;
function applause(){ if(!S.sound) return; try{ AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); if(AC.state==='suspended')AC.resume();
  const t=AC.currentTime; for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const n=AC.createBufferSource();const len=Math.floor(AC.sampleRate*0.06);const b=AC.createBuffer(1,len,AC.sampleRate);const d=b.getChannelData(0);for(let j=0;j<len;j++)d[j]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-j/len,2);n.buffer=b;
  const f=AC.createBiquadFilter();f.type='bandpass';f.frequency.value=1500+Math.random()*2500;const g=AC.createGain();g.gain.value=0.6;n.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);n.start(t+i*0.045+Math.random()*0.02)}
  const o=AC.createOscillator(),g2=AC.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(660,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1320,t+.25);g2.gain.setValueAtTime(.3,t);g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.5);o.connect(g2);g2.connect(AC.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.5);
 }catch(e){} }
function ctx(){try{AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(AC.state==='suspended')AC.resume();return AC}catch(e){return null}}
function tone(f,t0,dur,vol,type='sine'){const a=ctx();if(!a)return;const o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t0);g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t0);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol,t0+.008);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0005,t0+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(t0);o.stop(t0+dur+.05)}
function cling(){if(!S.sound)return;const a=ctx();if(!a)return;const t=a.currentTime;tone(1318,t,.35,.22);tone(1976,t+.01,.28,.12);tone(2637,t+.02,.18,.06)}   /* clopoțel discret, ca o notificare de calitate */
function chord(){if(!S.sound)return;const a=ctx();if(!a)return;const t=a.currentTime;[523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>{tone(f,t+i*.09,.7,.16,'triangle');tone(f*2,t+i*.09,.4,.05)})}
function burst(x,y){for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='burst';s.textContent=i%3?'•':'✦';s.style.left=x+'px';s.style.top=y+'px';s.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');s.style.setProperty('--dy',(-40-Math.random()*90)+'px');s.style.fontSize=(10+Math.random()*10)+'px';document.body.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),1100)}
  const r=document.createElement('span');r.className='ripple';r.style.left=x+'px';r.style.top=y+'px';document.body.appendChild(r);setTimeout(()=>r.remove(),700)}
function fireworks(){const cols=PAL;for(let k=0;k<6;k++){setTimeout(()=>{const cx=60+Math.random()*(window.innerWidth-120),cy=120+Math.random()*(window.innerHeight*0.5);const col=cols[k%cols.length];
  const ring=document.createElement('span');ring.className='fw';ring.style.left=cx+'px';ring.style.top=cy+'px';ring.style.borderColor=col;document.body.appendChild(ring);setTimeout(()=>ring.remove(),1300);
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const p=document.createElement('span');p.className='spark';p.style.left=cx+'px';p.style.top=cy+'px';p.style.background=col;const a=i/18*Math.PI*2,d=70+Math.random()*90;p.style.setProperty('--dx',Math.cos(a)*d+'px');p.style.setProperty('--dy',Math.sin(a)*d+'px');document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),1300)}},k*220)}confetti()}
function celebrate(msg){fireworks();applause();setTimeout(chord,300);toast(msg)}
let toastT;function toast(m){const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),1800)}
const PRAISE=['Bifat.','Încă una. Bine.','Ziua prinde formă.','Consecvență.','Asta se adună.','Pas cu pas.','Notat și făcut.'];

/* ---------- voice ---------- */
function listen(btn,onText){
  const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if(!SR){toast('Browserul acesta nu are dictare. Deschide noot.html în Chrome sau Safari.');return}
  if(btn.dataset.on==='1'){btn.dataset.on='0';return}
  try{const r=new SR();r.lang='ro-RO';r.interimResults=false;r.maxAlternatives=1;btn.dataset.on='1';
    r.onresult=e=>{btn.dataset.on='0';onText(e.results[0][0].transcript)};
    r.onerror=e=>{btn.dataset.on='0';toast(e.error==='not-allowed'||e.error==='service-not-allowed'?'Fereastra Claude blochează microfonul. Deschide fișierul noot.html în Chrome/Safari și vocea merge.':'Nu am înțeles. Încearcă din nou.')};
    r.onend=()=>{btn.dataset.on='0'};r.start()}catch(e){btn.dataset.on='0';toast('Microfonul nu e disponibil aici. Scrie textul în câmp.')}
}
const LOGO='<svg viewBox="0 0 180 180" aria-hidden="true" style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;flex:none"><rect width="180" height="180" rx="48" fill="var(--cal)"/><path d="M50 78L82 110 138 40" fill="none" stroke="var(--bg)" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="40" y="134" width="100" height="6" rx="3" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/><g fill="var(--accent)"><path transform="translate(60,137) scale(.75)" d="M0-10l2.6 7 7.4 3-7.4 3-2.6 7-2.6-7-7.4-3 7.4-3z"/><path transform="translate(90,137) scale(.95)" d="M0-10l2.6 7 7.4 3-7.4 3-2.6 7-2.6-7-7.4-3 7.4-3z"/><path transform="translate(120,137) scale(.75)" d="M0-10l2.6 7 7.4 3-7.4 3-2.6 7-2.6-7-7.4-3 7.4-3z"/></g></svg>';
const MICSVG='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0014 0M12 18v3M8 21h8"/></svg>';

/* ---------- natural-language calendar parser (RO) ---------- */
const MONTHS={ianuarie:1,februarie:2,martie:3,aprilie:4,mai:5,iunie:6,iulie:7,august:8,septembrie:9,octombrie:10,noiembrie:11,decembrie:12};
function parseEvent(text,now=new Date()){
  const norm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/ţ/g,'ț').replace(/ş/g,'ș').replace(/[âă]/g,'a').replace(/î/g,'i').replace(/ș/g,'s').replace(/ț/g,'t');
  const W={'unu':1,'una':1,'doua':2,'două':2,'trei':3,'patru':4,'cinci':5,'sase':6,'șase':6,'sapte':7,'șapte':7,'opt':8,'noua':9,'nouă':9,'zece':10,'unsprezece':11,'doisprezece':12,'douasprezece':12,'douăsprezece':12,'treisprezece':13,'paisprezece':14,'cincisprezece':15,'saisprezece':16,'șaisprezece':16,'saptesprezece':17,'șaptesprezece':17,'optsprezece':18,'nouasprezece':19,'nouăsprezece':19,'douazeci':20,'douăzeci':20};
  text=text.replace(/(^|\s)(la|de la|ora|intre|între|si|și|pana la|până la)\s+([a-zăâîșț]+)(?=\s|$|[,.;:])/gi,(a,p,k,w)=>W[w.toLowerCase()]!==undefined?p+k+' '+W[w.toLowerCase()]:a);
  text=text.replace(/\b(\d{1,2})\s*(?:(?:si|și)\s*)?jum[aă]t?[a-zăâ]*\b/gi,'$1:30').replace(/\b(\d{1,2})\s*(?:si|și)\s*un sfert\b/gi,'$1:15');
  let t=' '+text.replace(/\s+/g,' ')+' ';           // original casing, for the title
  let n=norm(t);
  const r={title:'',date:null,start:null,end:null,weekly:null};
  const cut=(m)=>{const i=n.indexOf(m);if(i<0)return;t=t.slice(0,i)+' '+t.slice(i+m.length);n=n.slice(0,i)+' '+n.slice(i+m.length)};
  const hh=(h,mm)=>String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+(mm||'00');
  const d=new Date(now);d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  // 1. explicit dates
  let m=n.match(new RegExp('\\b(\\d{1,2}) ('+Object.keys(MONTHS).join('|')+')( \\d{4})?\\b'));
  if(m){r.date=new Date(m[3]?+m[3]:d.getFullYear(),MONTHS[m[2]]-1,+m[1]);cut(m[0])}
  else{m=n.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})(?:[./-](\d{2,4}))?\b/);if(m&&+m[2]>=1&&+m[2]<=12){let y=m[3]?+m[3]:d.getFullYear();if(y<100)y+=2000;r.date=new Date(y,+m[2]-1,+m[1]);cut(m[0]);
    const m3=n.match(/\b(la|pana la|-)\s*(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})(?:[./-](\d{2,4}))?\b/);if(m3)cut(m3[0])}}
  // 2. time interval
  m=n.match(/\b(?:de la|intre)( ora)? (\d{1,2})(?:[:.,](\d{2}))? (?:la|pana la|si)( ora)? (\d{1,2})(?:[:.,](\d{2}))?\b/);
  if(m&&+m[2]<24&&+m[5]<24){let h1=+m[2],h2=+m[5];if(h2<=h1&&h2+12<24)h2+=12;r.start=hh(h1,m[3]);r.end=hh(h2,m[6]);cut(m[0])}
  else{m=n.match(/\b(?:la ora|ora|la) (\d{1,2})(?:[:.,](\d{2}))?\b/);if(m&&+m[1]<24){r.start=hh(+m[1],m[2]);r.end=hh(Math.min(23,+m[1]+1),m[2]);cut(m[0])}}
  // 3. relative days / weekdays
  if(!r.date){
    if(/\bpoimaine\b/.test(n)){r.date=new Date(d);r.date.setDate(d.getDate()+2);cut(n.match(/\bpoimaine\b/)[0])}
    else if(/\bmaine\b/.test(n)){r.date=new Date(d);r.date.setDate(d.getDate()+1);cut(n.match(/\bmaine\b/)[0])}
    else if(/\b(azi|astazi)\b/.test(n)){r.date=new Date(d);cut(n.match(/\b(azi|astazi)\b/)[0])}
    else{
      const names=[['duminica?',0],['lun(i|ea)',1],['mart(i|ea)',2],['miercur(i|ea)',3],['joia?',4],['viner(i|ea)',5],['samb(ata|ata)',6]];
      for(const [re,dow] of names){const mm=n.match(new RegExp('\\b('+re+')\\b'));if(mm){const w=mm[1];
        const weekly=/(ea|ia|ata|ica)$/.test(w)&&!/(luni|marti|miercuri|joi|vineri|sambata|duminica)$/.test(w)||/\bin fiecare\b/.test(n)||/\bfiecare\b/.test(n)||/\bsaptamanal\b/.test(n);
        let diff=(dow-d.getDay()+7)%7;if(diff===0&&!weekly&&r.start&&+r.start.slice(0,2)<=now.getHours())diff=7;
        r.date=new Date(d);r.date.setDate(d.getDate()+diff);if(weekly)r.weekly=dow;cut(mm[0]);const f=n.match(/\b(in )?fiecare\b/);if(f)cut(f[0]);const sw=n.match(/\bsaptamanal\b/);if(sw)cut(sw[0]);break}}
    }
  }
  if(!r.date)r.date=new Date(d);
  r.title=t.replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/^[\s,.;:-]+|[\s,.;:-]+$/g,'').replace(/\s+(în|in|pe|la|de|din|pe data de)$/i,'').replace(/^(adaugă|adauga) (în|in) calendar[:,]?\s*/i,'').trim();
  if(r.title)r.title=r.title[0].toUpperCase()+r.title.slice(1);
  r.dateKey=r.date.getFullYear()+'-'+String(r.date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(r.date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  return r;
}

/* ---------- quiz data ---------- */

 2:['întâlnire','obosit','sănătate','bucătărie','călătorie','a împrumuta','înțelept','cuptor','fericire','agendă'],

 en:{name:'Engleză',w:{1:['water','house','book','tomorrow','thank you','bread','friend','sun','dog','cat'],2:['meeting','tired','health','kitchen','journey','to borrow','wise','oven','happiness','schedule'],3:['to postpone','perseverance','stubborn','threshold','rust','hidden','to pamper','lenient','interruption','harsh']}},

 de:{name:'Germană',w:{1:['Wasser','Haus','Buch','morgen','danke','Brot','Freund','Sonne','Hund','Katze'],2:['Besprechung','müde','Gesundheit','Küche','Reise','leihen','weise','Ofen','Glück','Terminkalender'],3:['verschieben','Ausdauer','stur','Schwelle','Rost','versteckt','verwöhnen','nachsichtig','Unterbrechung','rau']}},
 it:{name:'Italiană',w:{1:['acqua','casa','libro','domani','grazie','pane','amico','sole','cane','gatto'],2:['riunione','stanco','salute','cucina','viaggio','prendere in prestito','saggio','forno','felicità','agenda'],3:['rimandare','perseveranza','testardo','soglia','ruggine','nascosto','viziare','indulgente','interruzione','aspro']}},

};

/* ---------- render ---------- */
const main=document.getElementById('main');
let view='day';
/* curated trios: [fond, accent, cerneală] as [h,s,l] */
const PALS=[
 {id:'lumiere',con:[24,60,48],name:'Lavandă · Indigo',bg:[40,48,93],ac:[240,30,66],ink:[228,40,16]},
 {id:'verde',con:[355,50,45],name:'Verde deschis · Verde închis',bg:[40,48,93],ac:[135,28,60],ink:[150,38,13]},

const hsl=(a,ds=0,dl=0)=>`hsl(${a[0]} ${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,a[1]+ds))}% ${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,a[2]+dl))}%)`;
function applyPal(){const p=PALS.find(x=>x.id===S.pal)||PALS[0];const r=document.documentElement.style;const dark=(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark')||(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')!=='light'&&matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  const v=dark?{bg:hsl(p.ink,-8,-14),surface:hsl(p.ink,-12,-10),surface2:hsl(p.ink,-14,-6),line:hsl(p.ink,-14,0),fg:hsl(p.bg,0,0),muted:hsl(p.ink,-18,40),accent:hsl(p.ac,6,14),accentSoft:hsl(p.ac,-6,-28),accentFg:hsl(p.ink,0,-16),cal:hsl(p.ink,0,40),calSoft:hsl(p.ink,-10,-6),calFg:hsl(p.ink,0,-16)}
   :{bg:hsl(p.bg),surface:hsl(p.bg,4,4),surface2:hsl(p.bg,-14,-6),line:hsl(p.bg,-20,-12),fg:hsl(p.ink),muted:hsl(p.ink,-20,28),accent:hsl(p.ac),accentSoft:hsl(p.ac,0,24),accentFg:hsl(p.ink),cal:hsl(p.ink,-8,10),calSoft:hsl(p.ink,-10,70),calFg:'#fff'};
  r.setProperty('--bg',v.bg);r.setProperty('--surface',v.surface);r.setProperty('--surface2',v.surface2);r.setProperty('--line',v.line);r.setProperty('--fg',v.fg);r.setProperty('--muted',v.muted);r.setProperty('--accent',v.accent);r.setProperty('--accent-soft',v.accentSoft);r.setProperty('--accent-fg',v.accentFg);r.setProperty('--cal',v.cal);r.setProperty('--cal-soft',v.calSoft);r.setProperty('--cal-fg',v.calFg);r.setProperty('--good',v.cal);r.setProperty('--warn',v.accent);r.setProperty('--work',dark?hsl(p.con,0,16):hsl(p.con))}
try{matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change',applyPal)}catch(e){}
function setHue(){S.hue=240;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--h',240);applyPal()}
const PAL=['#7575a9','#f4edde','#58628a'];
const DAILY=[['moto','Citat motivațional'],['wit','Umor britanic'],['fact','Știați că?'],['history','Astăzi în istorie'],['news','Știri pe scurt']];
const dailyPicker=()=>`<div class="chips">${DAILY.map(([v,l])=>`<button class="chip" data-qt="${v}" aria-pressed="${(S.quoteTone||'moto')===v}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
const palPicker=(sel)=>`<div class="pals">${PALS.map(p=>`<button class="palb" data-pal="${p.id}" aria-pressed="${sel===p.id}"><i><b style="background:${hsl(p.bg)}"></b><b style="background:${hsl(p.ac)}"></b><b style="background:${hsl(p.ink)}"></b></i><span>${p.name}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
function render(){setHue();if(!S.profile){document.getElementById('tabs').hidden=true;renderOnboarding();return}
  document.getElementById('tabs').hidden=false;const tabOf={day:'day',cal:'cal',todo:'todo',stats:'stats',more:'more',proj:'more',game:'more',album:'more',set:'more'};document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',b.dataset.v===tabOf[view]?'page':'false'));
  ({day:renderDay,cal:renderCal,todo:renderTodo,stats:renderStats,proj:renderProj,game:renderGame,set:renderSet,more:renderMore,album:renderAlbum})[view]();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
document.getElementById('tabs').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b){view=b.dataset.v;render()}});

/* onboarding */
let ob={step:0,g:null,age:null,rel:null,kids:0,kidStage:[],pets:{dog:0,cat:0}};
function renderOnboarding(){
  const steps=['culori','zilnic','gen','varsta','relatie','copii','animale'];
  const bar='<div class="steps">'+steps.map((s,i)=>'<i class="'+(i<=ob.step?'on':'')+'"></i>').join('')+'</div>';
  const chips=(arr,key,multi)=>'<div class="chips">'+arr.map(([v,l])=>`<button class="chip" data-k="${key}" data-v="${v}" aria-pressed="${multi?ob[key].includes(v):ob[key]===v}">${l}</button>`).join('')+'</div>';
  let body='';
    if(ob.step===0)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Alege-ți nuanțele</h2><p class="muted">Cremul rămâne la toate. Alegi perechea: o nuanță deschisă (accent) și una foarte închisă (text, calendar). Le poți schimba oricând din Setări.</p>${palPicker(S.pal||'lumiere')}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===1)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Ce vrei să citești dimineața?</h2><p class="muted">O singură frază, sub salut. Se schimbă zilnic.</p>${dailyPicker()}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===2)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Cum vrei să te cunosc?</h2><p class="muted">Rutina și sugestiile se vor adapta.</p>${chips([['f','Femeie'],['m','Bărbat']],'g')}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===3)body=`<div class="q"><h2>În ce etapă ești?</h2>${chips([['18-24','18–24'],['25-34','25–34'],['35-44','35–44'],['45-54','45–54'],['55-64','55–64'],['65+','65+']],'age')}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===4)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Status</h2>${chips([['singur',ob.g==='f'?'Singură':'Singur'],['relatie','Într-o relație'],['casatorit',ob.g==='f'?'Căsătorită':'Căsătorit'],['alt','Prefer să nu spun']],'rel')}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===5)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Copii</h2><div class="row"><span>Număr</span><span class="counter"><button data-c="kids" data-d="-1">−</button><b>${ob.kids}</b><button data-c="kids" data-d="1">+</button></span></div>${ob.kids>0?'<p class="eyebrow">Unde sunt</p>'+chips([['gradi','Grădiniță'],['scoala','Școală'],['liceu','Liceu'],['facultate','Facultate'],['mici','Acasă (mici)'],['mari','Adulți']],'kidStage',true):''}</div>`;
  if(ob.step===6)body=`<div class="q"><h2>Animale</h2><div class="row between"><span>🐶 Câini</span><span class="counter"><button data-c="dog" data-d="-1">−</button><b>${ob.pets.dog}</b><button data-c="dog" data-d="1">+</button></span></div><div class="row between"><span>🐱 Pisici</span><span class="counter"><button data-c="cat" data-d="-1">−</button><b>${ob.pets.cat}</b><button data-c="cat" data-d="1">+</button></span></div></div>`;
  const can=[true,true,ob.g,ob.age,ob.rel,true,true][ob.step];
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="ob"><div style="border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:880/370;max-width:100%;background:var(--surface2)"><img src="${CUP2}" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block"></div><div class="row" style="align-items:center;gap:12px">${LOGO.replace("width:34px;height:34px","width:64px;height:64px")}<div class="logo" style="color:var(--accent)">noot<i style="color:var(--fg)">.</i></div></div>${bar}${body}<div class="row between"><button class="btn ghost" id="obBack" ${ob.step===0?'disabled':''}>Înapoi</button><button class="btn" id="obNext" ${can?'':'disabled'}>${ob.step===6?'Începe':'Continuă'}</button></div></div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const k=b.dataset.k,v=b.dataset.v;if(Array.isArray(ob[k])){ob[k]=ob[k].includes(v)?ob[k].filter(x=>x!==v):[...ob[k],v]}else ob[k]=v;renderOnboarding()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-pal]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.pal=b.dataset.pal;applyPal();renderOnboarding()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-qt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.quoteTone=b.dataset.qt;renderOnboarding()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-c]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const c=b.dataset.c,d=+b.dataset.d;if(c==='kids')ob.kids=Math.max(0,Math.min(8,ob.kids+d));else ob.pets[c]=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,ob.pets[c]+d));renderOnboarding()});
  document.getElementById('obBack').onclick=()=>{ob.step--;renderOnboarding()};
  document.getElementById('obNext').onclick=()=>{if(ob.step<6){ob.step++;renderOnboarding();return}
    S.profile={g:ob.g,age:ob.age,rel:ob.rel,kids:ob.kids,kidStage:ob.kidStage,pets:ob.pets,name:''};if(!ob.huePicked)S.hue=18;
    if(!S.routine.length){S.routine=[...SUG[ob.g],...extraSug(S.profile)].map(([text,when,cat])=>({id:uid(),text,when,cat}))}
    save();render()};
}

function confetti(){const cols=PAL;for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const s=document.createElement('i');s.className='confetti';s.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';s.style.background=cols[i%cols.length];s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*.6)+'s';document.body.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),2600)}}
function starCount(){let n=0;for(const k in S.days)n+=(S.days[k].done||[]).length+(S.days[k].resist||[]).length;for(const l in S.todos)n+=S.todos[l].filter(t=>t.done).length;n+=S.project.done.length;return n}
function streakDays(){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-i);const D=S.days[d2k(d)];if(D&&D.done.length)s++;else if(i===0)continue;else break}return s}
/* day */

  const done=S.routine.filter(r=>D.done.includes(r.id)).length,tot=S.routine.length,pct=tot?Math.round(done/tot*100):0;
  const h=new Date().getHours();const greet=h<12?'Bună dimineața':h<18?'Bună ziua':'Bună seara';
  const when={dim:'Dimineața',pranz:'Prânz',seara:'Seara'};
  const list=w=>S.routine.filter(r=>r.when===w).map(r=>`<div class="task" data-id="${r.id}" data-done="${D.done.includes(r.id)?1:0}"><button class="box" aria-label="Bifează">${D.done.includes(r.id)?'✔':''}</button><span class="t">${esc(r.text)}</span><span class="tag">${r.cat==='eu'?'eu':'muncă'}</span><button class="del" aria-label="Șterge" data-del="${r.id}">×</button></div>`).join('')||'<p class="hint">Nimic aici încă.</p>';
