const HIST={'01-01':'1866 — Se promulgă prima Constituție a Principatelor Unite (în vigoare din iulie).','01-15':'1850 — Se naște Mihai Eminescu.','01-24':'1859 — Unirea Principatelor Române sub Alexandru Ioan Cuza.','02-02':'1942 — Se naște Mircea Lucescu.','02-14':'1876 — Alexander Graham Bell depune brevetul pentru telefon.','02-24':'1848 — Începe Revoluția de la Paris, scânteia „primăverii popoarelor”.','03-01':'Mărțișorul — tradiție veche de peste 8.000 de ani, înscrisă UNESCO.','03-08':'1857 — Protestul muncitoarelor din New York, originea Zilei Femeii.','03-14':'1879 — Se naște Albert Einstein.','03-27':'1918 — Unirea Basarabiei cu România.','04-01':'1976 — Se înființează Apple.','04-12':'1961 — Iuri Gagarin, primul om în spațiu.','04-15':'1912 — Se scufundă Titanicul.','04-23':'1616 — Mor Shakespeare și Cervantes.','05-09':'1877 — Proclamarea independenței României.','05-10':'1866 — Carol I sosește la București.','05-20':'1927 — Lindbergh traversează Atlanticul în zbor solo.','06-06':'1944 — Debarcarea din Normandia.','06-15':'1889 — Moare Mihai Eminescu.','06-26':'1945 — Se semnează Carta ONU.','07-04':'1776 — Declarația de Independență a SUA.','07-14':'1789 — Căderea Bastiliei.','07-20':'1969 — Omul pășește pe Lună.','08-06':'1945 — Bomba de la Hiroshima.','08-15':'1916 — România intră în Primul Război Mondial.','08-28':'1963 — Martin Luther King: „I have a dream”.','09-01':'1939 — Începe al Doilea Război Mondial.','09-11':'2001 — Atentatele din SUA.','09-28':'1928 — Fleming descoperă penicilina.','10-01':'1860 — Se înființează Universitatea din Iași, prima universitate modernă din România.','10-12':'1492 — Columb ajunge în America.','10-25':'1944 — Eliberarea Ardealului de Nord; Ziua Armatei Române.','10-28':'1886 — Se inaugurează Statuia Libertății, la New York.','10-29':'1929 — „Marțea neagră”, prăbușirea bursei din New York.','10-31':'1517 — Luther afișează cele 95 de teze.','11-09':'1989 — Cade Zidul Berlinului.','11-11':'1918 — Armistițiul; se încheie Primul Război Mondial.','11-19':'1863 — Lincoln rostește discursul de la Gettysburg.','11-28':'1918 — Unirea Bucovinei cu România.','12-01':'1918 — Marea Unire de la Alba Iulia.','12-10':'1901 — Se decernează primele premii Nobel.','12-16':'1989 — Începe Revoluția Română, la Timișoara.','12-17':'1903 — Frații Wright, primul zbor cu motor.','12-25':'1989 — Procesul și execuția soților Ceaușescu.','12-31':'1999 — Lumea așteaptă trecerea în anul 2000.'};
function histToday(){const d=new Date();const k=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');if(HIST[k])return [HIST[k],'Astăzi, '+d.getDate()+' '+d.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'long'})];
  const keys=Object.keys(HIST).sort();let best=keys[0],bd=999;for(const kk of keys){const [m,dd]=kk.split('-').map(Number);const dist=Math.abs(new Date(d.getFullYear(),m-1,dd)-new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()))/864e5;if(dist<bd){bd=dist;best=kk}}const [m,dd]=best.split('-').map(Number);return [HIST[best],'Pe '+dd+' '+new Date(2000,m-1,1).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'long'})]}
const tone=S.quoteTone||'moto';const dayN=new Date().getDate()+new Date().getMonth()*3;
let motto,mauth,mlabel='';
if(tone==='news'){motto='';mauth='';mlabel='news'}
else if(tone==='fact'){motto=FACTS[dayN%FACTS.length];mauth='';mlabel='Știați că?'}
else if(tone==='history'){const hh=histToday();motto=hh[0];mauth='';mlabel=hh[1]}
else{const src=tone==='wit'?WIT:MOTTOS;const mq=src[dayN%src.length];motto=mq[0];mauth=mq[1]}const streak=streakDays();
  const td=new Date();const mon=new Date(td);mon.setDate(td.getDate()-((td.getDay()+6)%7));
  const week=Array.from({length:7},(_,i)=>{const d=new Date(mon);d.setDate(mon.getDate()+i);const k=d2k(d);return `<button class="wd ${k===todayKey()?'today':''}" data-wk="${k}"><small>${d.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{weekday:'short'}).replace('.','')}</small>${d.getDate()}${eventsOn(k).length?'<i class="dot"></i>':'<i class="dot" style="opacity:0"></i>'}</button>`}).join('');
  const todayEv=eventsOn(todayKey());
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view">
  <div class="topbar"><div class="brand" style="color:var(--accent)">${LOGO} noot<i style="color:var(--fg)">.</i></div><div class="row" style="gap:8px"><span class="stars" title="Stele adunate">★ ${starCount()}</span><button class="avatar" id="goSet" aria-label="Setări">${p.name?esc(p.name[0].toUpperCase()):'☺'}</button></div></div>
  <div><p class="eyebrow">${dateStr}</p><div class="hero2"><div class="txt"><h1>${greet}${p.name?', <i>'+esc(p.name)+'</i>':''}<i>.</i></h1>${mlabel==='news'?`<div id="newsBox" style="margin-top:8px"><p class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--work)">Știri pe scurt</p><p class="hint">Se încarcă…</p></div>`:mlabel?`<p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:8px;color:var(--work)">${mlabel}</p>`:''}${mlabel==='news'?'':`<p class="motto" ${mlabel?'style="margin-top:2px;font-style:normal;font-size:1.1rem"':''}>${mlabel?motto:'„'+motto+'”'}</p>`}${mauth?`<p class="hint" style="margin-top:2px;font-weight:700">— ${mauth}</p>`:''}<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><span class="streak">${streak} ${streak===1?'zi':'zile'} la rând</span><span class="streak">${D.done.length} bife azi</span></div></div></div></div>
  <div class="week"><button class="arr" id="wkCal" aria-label="Calendar">‹</button><div class="days">${week}</div><button class="arr" id="wkCal2" aria-label="Calendar">›</button></div>
  ${todayEv.length?`<div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico b">▦</div><div class="tt"><h3>Agenda de azi</h3><p>${todayEv.length} ${todayEv.length===1?'activitate':'activități'}</p></div></div>${todayEv.map(e=>`<div class="ev"><span class="time">${e.start?e.start+'–'+e.end:'Toată ziua'}</span><span class="tt">${esc(e.title)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}
  ${(()=>{const pr=[...S.todos.personal.filter(t=>!t.done&&(t.pri==='hi'||t.pri==='mid')).map(t=>[t,'personal']),...S.todos.work.filter(t=>!t.done&&(t.pri==='hi'||t.pri==='mid')).map(t=>[t,'work'])].sort((a,b)=>PORD[a[0].pri]-PORD[b[0].pri]);
    return `<div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico r">!</div><div class="tt"><h3>Prioritățile zilei</h3><p>${pr.length?pr.filter(x=>x[0].pri==='hi').length+' urgente · '+pr.filter(x=>x[0].pri==='mid').length+' importante':'Nimic urgent. Respiră.'}</p></div><button class="btn ghost small" id="goTodo">Liste</button></div>${pr.slice(0,6).map(([t,l])=>todoRow(t,l)).join('')}</div>`})()}
  ${(()=>{const G=D.goals||(D.goals=[]);const doneG=G.filter(g=>g.done).length;return `<div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico p">◎</div><div class="tt"><h3>Obiectivele zilei</h3><p>${G.length?doneG+' din '+G.length+' atinse':'Maximum trei. Ce contează azi?'}</p></div>${G.length?`<span class="pct">${doneG}/${G.length}</span>`:''}</div>
    ${G.map(g=>`<div class="task" data-gid="${g.id}" data-done="${g.done?1:0}"><button class="box" aria-label="Atins">${g.done?'✔':''}</button><span class="t">${esc(g.text)}</span><button class="del" data-gdel="${g.id}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></div>`).join('')}
    ${G.length<3?`<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><input type="text" id="newGoal" placeholder="Obiectivul ${G.length+1}…" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" id="micGoal" aria-label="Dictează">${MICSVG}</button><button class="btn small" id="addGoal">Adaugă</button></div>`:''}</div>`})()}
  <div class="card ${pct===100?'done':''}"><div class="sec"><div class="ico y">✓</div><div class="tt"><h3>Rutina zilnică</h3><p>${pct===100?'Completă! Ziua e a ta. 🌟':'Esențialele tale · '+done+' din '+tot+' bifate'}</p><p style="font-size:.82rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--work);font-weight:700">☕ Se completează a doua zi, la cafea.</p></div><span class="pct">${pct}%</span></div><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px"><i class="${D.done.length?'glow':''}" style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
    ${['dim','pranz','seara'].map(w=>`<p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:14px">${when[w]}</p>${list(w)}`).join('')}
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><input type="text" id="newTask" placeholder="Adaugă la rutina mea…" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><select id="newWhen" style="width:auto"><option value="dim">Dimineața</option><option value="pranz">Prânz</option><option value="seara">Seara</option></select><select id="newCat" style="width:auto"><option value="eu">Eu</option><option value="munca">Muncă</option></select><button class="mic" id="micTask" aria-label="Adaugă vocal">${MICSVG}</button><button class="btn small" id="addTask">Adaugă</button></div>
    <p class="hint">Apasă microfonul și spune: „adaugă la rutina mea zilnică: m-am dat cu cremă”.</p></div>
  ${(()=>{const R=D.resist||(D.resist=[]);const streakOf=id=>{let s=0;for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-i);const dd=S.days[d2k(d)];if(dd&&(dd.resist||[]).includes(id))s++;else if(i===0)continue;else break}return s};
    return `<div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico p">✕</div><div class="tt"><h3>Obiceiuri de lăsat</h3><p>Bifezi seara: „azi am rezistat”.</p></div></div>
    ${S.habits.map(x=>`<div class="task" data-hid="${x.id}" data-done="${R.includes(x.id)?1:0}"><button class="box" aria-label="Azi am rezistat">${R.includes(x.id)?'✔':''}</button><span class="t">${esc(x.text)}</span><span class="tag">${streakOf(x.id)} ${streakOf(x.id)===1?'zi':'zile'}</span><button class="del" data-hdel="${x.id}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></div>`).join('')||'<p class="hint">Ex: scroll pe telefon seara, zahăr, fumat, amânat. Adaugă unul.</p>'}
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><input type="text" id="newHabit" placeholder="Obicei la care vreau să renunț…" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" id="micHabit" aria-label="Adaugă vocal">${MICSVG}</button><button class="btn small" id="addHabit">Adaugă</button></div>
    ${S.habits.length?'':'<div class="chips" style="margin-top:10px">'+['Scroll pe telefon seara','Zahăr','Fumat','Amânat','Cafea după ora 16','Culcat târziu'].map(s=>`<button class="chip" data-hs="${s}">+ ${s}</button>`).join('')+'</div>'}</div>`})()}
  <div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico g">↗</div><div class="tt"><h3>Mișcare</h3><p>Pași, kilometri, sală, alte sporturi</p></div></div><div class="tiles mv" style="margin-top:10px;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)"><label class="f">🚶 Pași<input type="number" id="steps" value="${D.steps}" placeholder="0"></label><label class="f">🚴 Kilometri<input type="number" id="km" value="${D.km}" placeholder="0"></label><label class="f">🏋️ Sală (min.)<input type="number" id="sport" value="${D.sport}" placeholder="0"></label><label class="f">🏊 Alte sporturi (min.)<input type="number" id="other" value="${D.other||''}" placeholder="0"></label></div></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico p">✦</div><div class="tt"><h3>Visul meu</h3><p>Un pas pe zi</p></div></div><p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 10px">${S.dream?esc(S.dream):'Scrie visul tău mare în Setări.'}</p><p class="eyebrow">Ce ai făcut azi pentru visul tău?</p><textarea id="dreamToday" placeholder="Un pas mic contează…">${esc(D.dream)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico p">✎</div><div class="tt"><h3>Gândurile zilei</h3><p>Notițe libere, idei, ce nu vrei să uiți</p></div><button class="mic" id="micNote" aria-label="Dictează" style="width:40px;height:40px">${MICSVG}</button></div><textarea id="dayNote" placeholder="Scrie sau dictează…">${esc(D.note||'')}</textarea></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="sec"><div class="ico b">☾</div><div class="tt"><h3>Rezumatul zilei</h3><p>Două întrebări, seara</p></div></div><p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:10px">Cum a fost ziua?</p><div class="chips" id="rating">${[['Bună','☀️'],['Mulțumitoare','🙂'],['Satisfăcătoare','👍'],['Productivă','🚀'],['Liniștită','🌿'],['Grea','🌧️']].map(([x,e])=>`<button class="chip" data-v="${x}" aria-pressed="${D.dayRating===x}">${e} ${x}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:12px">Cum te-ai simțit azi?</p><div class="chips" id="mood">${(fem?[['Veselă','😊'],['Calmă','😌'],['Mândră','🥰'],['Recunoscătoare','🙏'],['Obosită','😴'],['Stresată','😣'],['Supărată','😠'],['Tristă','😢']]:[['Vesel','😊'],['Calm','😌'],['Mândru','🥰'],['Recunoscător','🙏'],['Obosit','😴'],['Stresat','😣'],['Supărat','😠'],['Trist','😢']]).map(([x,e])=>`<button class="chip" data-v="${x}" aria-pressed="${D.mood===x}">${e} ${x}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:12px">⚡ Energie</p><div class="chips" id="energy">${[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<button class="chip" data-v="${n}" aria-pressed="${D.energy===n}">${'⚡'.repeat(n)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><label class="f">😴 Ore de somn (noaptea trecută)<input type="number" id="sleep" step="0.5" value="${D.sleep||''}" placeholder="7.5"></label></div>
    <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:12px">🙏 Un lucru bun de azi</p><div class="row"><input type="text" id="good" value="${esc(D.good||'')}" placeholder="Ex: cafeaua cu Laura, un pacient mulțumit…" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" id="micGood" aria-label="Dictează">${MICSVG}</button></div>
    <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:12px">📌 Un gând pentru mâine</p><textarea id="tomorrow" placeholder="Ce vreau să nu uit mâine…" style="min-height:60px">${esc(D.tomorrow||'')}</textarea></div>
  </div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('.task[data-id] .box').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{const id=b.closest('.task').dataset.id;const i=D.done.indexOf(id);if(i>=0)D.done.splice(i,1);else{D.done.push(id);const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left+16,r.top+16);cling();
      const pctNow=Math.round(D.done.length/Math.max(1,S.routine.length)*100);
      if(pctNow>=90&&!D.cel90){D.cel90=true;setTimeout(()=>celebrate(pctNow===100?'Rutina completă. Ziua e a ta.':'Peste 90%. Zi stăpânită.'),250)}
      else if(D.done.length===1){const st=streakDays();if([3,7,14,21,30,60,100].includes(st)){setTimeout(()=>{chord();toast(st+' zile la rând. Asta se numește disciplină.')},300)}else toast(PRAISE[Math.floor(Math.random()*PRAISE.length)])}
      else toast(PRAISE[Math.floor(Math.random()*PRAISE.length)])}save();renderDay()});
  const addHabit=v=>{v=(v||'').replace(/^(adaugă|adauga)\s+(obicei(ul)?)?[:,]?\s*/i,'').trim();if(!v)return;S.habits.push({id:uid(),text:v[0].toUpperCase()+v.slice(1)});save();renderDay();toast('Adăugat')};
  document.getElementById('addHabit').onclick=()=>addHabit(document.getElementById('newHabit').value);
  document.getElementById('newHabit').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')addHabit(e.target.value)};
  document.getElementById('micHabit').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,addHabit);
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-hs]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>addHabit(b.dataset.hs));
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-hid] .box').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const id=b.closest('.task').dataset.hid;const R=D.resist||(D.resist=[]);const i=R.indexOf(id);if(i>=0)R.splice(i,1);else{R.push(id);const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left+16,r.top+16);cling();toast('Încă o zi câștigată.')}save();renderDay()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-hdel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.habits=S.habits.filter(x=>x.id!==b.dataset.hdel);save();renderDay()});
  const Gs=D.goals||(D.goals=[]);const addGoal=v=>{v=(v||'').trim();if(!v||Gs.length>=3)return;Gs.push({id:uid(),text:v[0].toUpperCase()+v.slice(1),done:false});save();renderDay();cling()};
  const ng=document.getElementById('newGoal');if(ng){ng.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')addGoal(e.target.value)};document.getElementById('addGoal').onclick=()=>addGoal(ng.value);document.getElementById('micGoal').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,addGoal)}
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-gid] .box').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const g=Gs.find(x=>x.id===b.closest('.task').dataset.gid);g.done=!g.done;if(g.done){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left+16,r.top+16);if(Gs.every(x=>x.done)&&Gs.length>=2)setTimeout(()=>celebrate('Toate obiectivele zilei. Atât trebuia.'),200);else{chord();toast('Obiectiv atins.')}}save();renderDay()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-gdel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{D.goals=Gs.filter(x=>x.id!==b.dataset.gdel);save();renderDay()});
  document.getElementById('dayNote').oninput=e=>{D.note=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('micNote').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,t=>{D.note=(D.note?D.note+'\n':'')+t;save();renderDay()});
  const nb=document.getElementById('newsBox');if(nb){const row=(n,i)=>`<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:5px 0"><b style="color:var(--work);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${i+1}</b><div style="min-width:0"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.3">${esc(n.title)}</div>${n.source?`<div class="hint" style="font-size:.75rem">${esc(n.source)}</div>`:''}</div></div>`;
    const show=d=>{nb.innerHTML=`<p class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--work)">Știri pe scurt · România</p>${d.ro.map(row).join('')}<p class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--work);margin-top:8px">Externe</p>${d.ext.map(row).join('')}<p class="hint" style="font-size:.72rem;margin-top:4px">Titluri din presă, actualizate la ${new Date(d.at).toLocaleTimeString('ro-RO',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}.</p>`};
    let cached=null;try{cached=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('noot.news'))}catch(e){}
    if(cached&&Date.now()-new Date(cached.at)<3600e3)show(cached);
    else fetch('/.netlify/functions/news').then(r=>r.ok?r.json():Promise.reject()).then(d=>{if(!d.ro||!d.ro.length)throw 0;show(d);try{localStorage.setItem('noot.news',JSON.stringify(d))}catch(e){}}).catch(()=>{if(cached)show(cached);else nb.innerHTML=`<p class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--work)">Știri pe scurt</p><p class="hint">Știrile se încarcă doar în versiunea instalată (adresa .netlify.app). Aici alege altă opțiune din Setări.</p>`})}
  document.getElementById('goSet').onclick=()=>{view='set';render()};document.getElementById('goTodo').onclick=()=>{view='todo';render()};bindTodoRows(main,renderDay);
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-wk]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{calSel=b.dataset.wk;calView='day';view='cal';render()});
  document.getElementById('wkCal').onclick=document.getElementById('wkCal2').onclick=()=>{calView='week';view='cal';render()};
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-del]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.routine=S.routine.filter(r=>r.id!==b.dataset.del);save();renderDay()});
  const add=txt=>{txt=(txt||'').replace(/^(adaugă|adauga)\s+(la|în|in)\s+rutina( mea)?( zilnică| zilnica)?[:,]?\s*/i,'').trim();if(!txt)return;S.routine.push({id:uid(),text:txt[0].toUpperCase()+txt.slice(1),when:document.getElementById('newWhen').value,cat:document.getElementById('newCat').value});save();renderDay();toast('Adăugat în rutină')};
  document.getElementById('addTask').onclick=()=>add(document.getElementById('newTask').value);
  document.getElementById('newTask').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')add(e.target.value)};
  document.getElementById('micTask').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,add);
  ['steps','km','sport','other'].forEach(k=>document.getElementById(k).oninput=e=>{D[k]=e.target.value;save()});
  document.getElementById('dreamToday').oninput=e=>{D.dream=e.target.value;save()};
  main.querySelectorAll('#rating .chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{D.dayRating=b.dataset.v;save();renderDay()});
  main.querySelectorAll('#mood .chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{D.mood=b.dataset.v;save();if(D.dayRating){chord();toast('Ziua e închisă. Ne vedem mâine, la cafea.')}renderDay()});
  main.querySelectorAll('#energy .chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{D.energy=+b.dataset.v;save();renderDay()});
  document.getElementById('sleep').oninput=e=>{D.sleep=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('good').oninput=e=>{D.good=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('micGood').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,t=>{D.good=t;save();renderDay()});
  document.getElementById('tomorrow').oninput=e=>{D.tomorrow=e.target.value;save()};
}

/* calendar */
let calM=(()=>{const d=new Date();return{y:d.getFullYear(),m:d.getMonth()}})(),calSel=todayKey(),calMode='agenda';
const k2d=k=>{const [y,m,d]=k.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d)};
const d2k=d=>d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
function repOf(e){return e.repeat||(e.weekly!==null&&e.weekly!==undefined?'weekly':'none')}
function eventsOn(k){const dt=k2d(k);return S.events.filter(e=>{if(e.date===k)return true;if(k<e.date)return false;if(e.until&&k>e.until)return false;const r=repOf(e);if(r==='daily')return true;if(r==='weekly')return dt.getDay()===k2d(e.date).getDay();if(r==='monthly')return dt.getDate()===k2d(e.date).getDate();return false}).sort((a,b)=>(a.start||'').localeCompare(b.start||''))}
const REP={none:'',daily:'zilnic',weekly:'săptămânal',monthly:'lunar'};
let calView='month';
function periodInfo(){const days=[...S.period].sort();const starts=[];days.forEach((k,i)=>{if(i===0||(k2d(k)-k2d(days[i-1]))/864e5>2)starts.push(k)});let cycle=28;if(starts.length>=2){const gaps=[];for(let i=1;i<starts.length;i++)gaps.push((k2d(starts[i])-k2d(starts[i-1]))/864e5);cycle=Math.round(gaps.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/gaps.length)}
  const last=starts[starts.length-1];let next=null;if(last){next=k2d(last);next.setDate(next.getDate()+cycle)}return{starts,cycle,last,next}}
const hourSel=(id,H)=>`<select id="${id}" aria-label="Ora">${Array.from({length:24},(_,i)=>`<option value="${String(i).padStart(2,'0')}" ${i===H?'selected':''}>${String(i).padStart(2,'0')}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
const minSel=(id,M)=>`<select id="${id}" aria-label="Minute">${[0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55].map(m=>`<option value="${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}" ${m===M?'selected':''}>${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
function monthGrid(y,m,opts){const first=new Date(y,m,1);const pad=(first.getDay()+6)%7;const n=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();let cells='';for(let i=0;i<pad;i++)cells+='<div class="d pad"></div>';
  for(let d=1;d<=n;d++){const k=d2k(new Date(y,m,d));cells+=opts.cell(k,d)}return cells}
function renderCal(){
  const fem=S.profile.g==='f';
  const pi=fem?periodInfo():null;const predKeys=new Set();if(pi&&pi.next){for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const d=new Date(pi.next);d.setDate(d.getDate()+i);predKeys.add(d2k(d))}}
  const sel=k2d(calSel);
  const evRow=e=>`<div class="ev"><span class="time">${e.start?e.start+'–'+e.end:'Toată ziua'}</span><span class="tt">${esc(e.title)}${repOf(e)!=='none'?' <span class="tag" style="font-size:.65rem">'+REP[repOf(e)]+(e.until?' până la '+k2d(e.until).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{day:'numeric',month:'short'}):'')+'</span>':''}</span><button class="del" data-ev="${e.id}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></div>`;
  const nav=(label)=>`<div class="row between"><button class="btn ghost small" id="pv">‹</button><h3 style="text-transform:capitalize">${label}</h3><button class="btn ghost small" id="nx">›</button></div>`;
  let body='';
  if(calMode==='ciclu'){
    body=`<div class="card">${nav(new Date(calM.y,calM.m,1).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}))}<div class="cal" style="margin-top:10px">${['Lu','Ma','Mi','Jo','Vi','Sâ','Du'].map(x=>'<div class="dow">'+x+'</div>').join('')}${monthGrid(calM.y,calM.m,{cell:(k,d)=>{const per=S.period.includes(k),pred=predKeys.has(k)&&!per;return `<button class="d ${k===todayKey()?'today':''} ${per?'per':''} ${pred?'pred':''}" data-k="${k}">${d}</button>`}})}</div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Menstruație</h3><p class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 10px">Apasă pe zilele cu menstruație. Zilele conturate sunt estimarea următoarei.</p>
    <div class="tiles"><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Interval mediu</p><span class="big">${pi.cycle}</span> zile</div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Ultima</p><b>${pi.last?k2d(pi.last).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{day:'numeric',month:'short'}):'—'}</b></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Următoarea (est.)</p><b>${pi.next?pi.next.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{day:'numeric',month:'short'}):'—'}</b></div></div></div>`;
  }else if(calView==='day'){
    const evs=eventsOn(calSel);
    body=`<div class="card">${nav(sel.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'}))}<div style="margin-top:8px">${evs.map(evRow).join('')||'<p class="hint">Nicio activitate.</p>'}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:8px">${Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>i+7).map(hr=>{const hh=String(hr).padStart(2,'0');const here=evs.filter(e=>e.start&&+e.start.slice(0,2)===hr);return `<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;min-height:30px;align-items:flex-start"><span class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:38px;flex:none;font-weight:800">${hh}:00</span><span style="flex:1;min-width:0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:2px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600">${here.map(e=>`<span style="display:inline-block;background:var(--cal-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:2px 8px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0">${e.start}–${e.end} ${esc(e.title)}</span>`).join('')}</span></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }else if(calView==='week'){
    const mon=new Date(sel);mon.setDate(sel.getDate()-((sel.getDay()+6)%7));const days=Array.from({length:7},(_,i)=>{const d=new Date(mon);d.setDate(mon.getDate()+i);return d});
    const sun=days[6];
    body=`<div class="card">${nav(mon.getDate()+' '+mon.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'short'})+' – '+sun.getDate()+' '+sun.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'short'}))}
      <div class="stack" style="margin-top:10px">${days.map(d=>{const k=d2k(d);const evs=eventsOn(k);return `<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)"><button class="d ${k===todayKey()?'today':''} ${k===calSel?'sel':''}" data-k="${k}" style="width:46px;aspect-ratio:auto;height:46px;flex:none;font-size:.8rem"><span style="font-size:.6rem;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7">${d.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{weekday:'short'}).replace('.','')}</span>${d.getDate()}</button><div style="flex:1;min-width:0">${evs.map(e=>`<div style="font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600"><span style="color:var(--cal);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800">${e.start?e.start+' ':''}</span>${esc(e.title)}</div>`).join('')||'<span class="hint">—</span>'}</div></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }else if(calView==='year'){
    body=`<div class="card">${nav(String(calM.y))}<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px">${Array.from({length:12},(_,m)=>{const cnt=(()=>{let c=0;const n=new Date(calM.y,m+1,0).getDate();for(let d=1;d<=n;d++)if(eventsOn(d2k(new Date(calM.y,m,d))).length)c++;return c})();
      return `<button data-month="${m}" style="text-align:left;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:12px;padding:8px"><p class="eyebrow" style="text-transform:capitalize;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:4px">${new Date(calM.y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'long'})}</p><div class="cal" style="gap:1px">${monthGrid(calM.y,m,{cell:(k,d)=>{const has=eventsOn(k).length;return `<div class="d" style="font-size:.6rem;border-radius:4px;${has?'background:var(--cal-soft);font-weight:800':''}${k===todayKey()?';outline:1.5px solid var(--cal);outline-offset:-1px':''}">${d}</div>`}})}</div><p class="hint" style="margin-top:4px;font-size:.72rem">${cnt?cnt+' zile cu activități':'liber'}</p></button>`}).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }else{
    body=`<div class="card">${nav(new Date(calM.y,calM.m,1).toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}))}<div class="cal" style="margin-top:10px">${['Lu','Ma','Mi','Jo','Vi','Sâ','Du'].map(x=>'<div class="dow">'+x+'</div>').join('')}${monthGrid(calM.y,calM.m,{cell:(k,d)=>`<button class="d ${k===todayKey()?'today':''} ${k===calSel?'sel':''}" data-k="${k}">${d}${eventsOn(k).length?'<i class="dot"></i>':''}</button>`})}</div></div>
      <div class="card"><p class="eyebrow">${sel.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'})}</p>${eventsOn(calSel).map(evRow).join('')||'<p class="hint" style="margin-top:6px">Nicio activitate.</p>'}</div>`;
  }
  const add=calMode==='agenda'?`<div class="card"><h3>Adaugă activitate</h3>
    <div class="stack" style="margin-top:10px">
    <label class="f">Ce ai de făcut<div class="row" style="gap:8px"><input type="text" id="mTitle" placeholder="Ex: Consultații" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" id="micEv" aria-label="Dictează">${MICSVG}</button></div></label>
    <p class="hint">Poți dicta totul odată: „Consultații, miercurea de la 9 la 13”. Ziua și ora se completează singure mai jos.</p>
    <label class="f">Data<input type="date" id="mDate" value="${calSel}"></label>
    <label class="f">De la<span class="timesel">${hourSel('mSh',9)}<b>:</b>${minSel('mSm',0)}</span></label>
    <label class="f">Până la<span class="timesel">${hourSel('mEh',10)}<b>:</b>${minSel('mEm',0)}</span></label>
    <label class="row" style="font-weight:600"><input type="checkbox" id="mAll"> Toată ziua (fără oră)</label>
    <label class="f">Se repetă<select id="mRep"><option value="none">Nu</option><option value="daily">Zilnic</option><option value="weekly">Săptămânal</option><option value="monthly">Lunar</option></select></label>
    <label class="f" id="mUntilWrap" hidden>Până la data<input type="date" id="mUntil"></label>
    <button class="btn" id="mAdd" style="width:100%;min-height:52px;font-size:1.05rem">Salvează activitatea</button></div></div>`:'';
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><div class="row between"><h1>Calendar</h1>${fem?`<div class="chips"><button class="chip" data-m="agenda" aria-pressed="${calMode==='agenda'}">Agendă</button><button class="chip" data-m="ciclu" aria-pressed="${calMode==='ciclu'}">Menstruație</button></div>`:''}</div>
    ${calMode==='agenda'?`<div class="chips">${[['day','Zi'],['week','Săptămână'],['month','Lună'],['year','An']].map(([v,l])=>`<button class="chip" data-cv="${v}" aria-pressed="${calView===v}">${l}</button>`).join('')}<button class="chip" id="goToday">Azi</button></div>`:''}
    ${body}${add}</div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-m]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{calMode=b.dataset.m;renderCal()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-cv]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{calView=b.dataset.cv;renderCal()});
  const gt=document.getElementById('goToday');if(gt)gt.onclick=()=>{calSel=todayKey();const d=new Date();calM={y:d.getFullYear(),m:d.getMonth()};renderCal()};
  const step=dir=>{if(calMode==='ciclu'||calView==='month'){calM.m+=dir;if(calM.m<0){calM.m=11;calM.y--}if(calM.m>11){calM.m=0;calM.y++}}
    else if(calView==='year')calM.y+=dir;else{const d=k2d(calSel);d.setDate(d.getDate()+dir*(calView==='week'?7:1));calSel=d2k(d);calM={y:d.getFullYear(),m:d.getMonth()}}renderCal()};
  document.getElementById('pv').onclick=()=>step(-1);document.getElementById('nx').onclick=()=>step(1);
  main.querySelectorAll('.cal .d[data-k], .d[data-k]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const k=b.dataset.k;if(calMode==='ciclu'){const i=S.period.indexOf(k);if(i>=0)S.period.splice(i,1);else S.period.push(k);save()}else{calSel=k;if(calView==='week')calView='day'}renderCal()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-month]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{calM.m=+b.dataset.month;calView='month';calSel=d2k(new Date(calM.y,calM.m,1));renderCal()});
  if(calMode==='agenda'){
    const setForm=r=>{document.getElementById('mDate').value=r.dateKey;if(r.start){document.getElementById('mAll').checked=false;document.getElementById('mSh').value=r.start.slice(0,2);document.getElementById('mSm').value=r.start.slice(3);document.getElementById('mEh').value=r.end.slice(0,2);document.getElementById('mEm').value=r.end.slice(3)}if(r.weekly!==null){document.getElementById('mRep').value='weekly';document.getElementById('mUntilWrap').hidden=false;const d=new Date(r.date);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+3);document.getElementById('mUntil').value=d2k(d)}document.getElementById('mTitle').value=r.title};
    document.getElementById('micEv').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,t=>{const r=parseEvent(t);setForm(r);toast('Verifică și apasă Salvează')});
    document.getElementById('mTitle').onchange=e=>{const v=e.target.value;if(/\b(luni|mar[tț]i|miercuri|joi|vineri|s[âa]mb|duminic|m[âa]ine|azi|ora|de la|\d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}|\d{1,2}\s*(jumate|jum))/i.test(v)){const r=parseEvent(v);if(r.title&&(r.start||r.weekly!==null||r.dateKey!==todayKey()))setForm(r)}};
    document.getElementById('mTitle').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.target.blur();document.getElementById('mAdd').click()}};
    document.getElementById('mRep').onchange=e=>{document.getElementById('mUntilWrap').hidden=e.target.value==='none'};
    document.getElementById('mAdd').onclick=()=>{let t=document.getElementById('mTitle').value.trim();if(!t){toast('Scrie ce ai de făcut');document.getElementById('mTitle').focus();return}
      const d=document.getElementById('mDate').value||calSel;const all=document.getElementById('mAll').checked;let st=all?null:document.getElementById('mSh').value+':'+document.getElementById('mSm').value,en=all?null:document.getElementById('mEh').value+':'+document.getElementById('mEm').value;if(en&&st&&en<=st){toast('Ora de final trebuie să fie după cea de început');return}
      const rep=document.getElementById('mRep').value;const until=rep!=='none'?(document.getElementById('mUntil').value||null):null;if(until&&until<d){toast('Data de final trebuie să fie după data de început');return}
      S.events.push({id:uid(),title:t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1),date:d,start:st,end:en,repeat:rep,until});calSel=d;calM={y:k2d(d).getFullYear(),m:k2d(d).getMonth()};save();cling();renderCal();toast('Salvat: '+t);window.scrollTo(0,0)};
    main.querySelectorAll('[data-ev]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.events=S.events.filter(e=>e.id!==b.dataset.ev);save();renderCal()});
  }
}

/* stats */
function renderStats(){
  const keys=[];for(let i=13;i>=0;i--){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-i);keys.push(d2k(d))}
  const tot=S.routine.length||1;
  const rows=keys.map(k=>{const D=S.days[k];const done=D?D.done.filter(id=>S.routine.some(r=>r.id===id)):[];const me=done.filter(id=>S.routine.find(r=>r.id===id).cat==='eu').length;const wk=done.length-me;return{k,me,wk,pct:Math.round(done.length/tot*100),d:k2d(k)}});
  const streak=(()=>{let s=0;for(let i=rows.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(rows[i].pct>0)s++;else if(i===rows.length-1)continue;else break}return s})();
  const avg=Math.round(rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.pct,0)/rows.length);
  const meT=rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.me,0),wkT=rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.wk,0);
  const steps=keys.reduce((a,k)=>a+(+(S.days[k]&&S.days[k].steps)||0),0),km=keys.reduce((a,k)=>a+(+(S.days[k]&&S.days[k].km)||0),0),sport=keys.reduce((a,k)=>a+(+(S.days[k]&&S.days[k].sport)||0),0),other=keys.reduce((a,k)=>a+(+(S.days[k]&&S.days[k].other)||0),0);
  const maxS=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r.me+r.wk));
  const moods={};keys.forEach(k=>{const m=S.days[k]&&S.days[k].mood;if(m)moods[m]=(moods[m]||0)+1});
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Grafice</h1>
  <div class="tiles"><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Consecvență 14 zile</p><span class="big">${avg}%</span></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Zile la rând</p><span class="big">${streak}</span></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Pentru mine</p><span class="big" style="color:var(--cal)">${meT}</span> bife</div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">Pentru muncă</p><span class="big" style="color:var(--work)">${wkT}</span> bife</div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Eu vs. muncă</h3><p class="hint">Bife pe zi, ultimele 14 zile.</p><div class="bars">${rows.map(r=>`<div class="b"><div style="width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;height:100%;gap:1px"><i class="me ${r.me?'':'zero'}" style="height:${r.me/maxS*100}%"></i><i class="${r.wk?'':'zero'}" style="height:${r.wk/maxS*100}%"></i></div><span>${r.d.getDate()}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="legend" style="margin-top:8px"><span><i style="background:var(--cal)"></i>Eu</span><span><i style="background:var(--work)"></i>Muncă</span></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Consecvența rutinei</h3><p class="hint">Procent din rutină bifat în fiecare zi.</p><div class="bars">${rows.map(r=>`<div class="b"><i class="${r.pct?'':'zero'}" style="height:${r.pct}%;background:${r.pct>=70?'var(--cal)':r.pct>=35?'var(--accent)':'var(--accent-soft)'};box-shadow:none"></i><span>${r.d.getDate()}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Mișcare (14 zile)</h3><div class="tiles" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">🚶 Pași</p><b>${steps.toLocaleString('ro-RO')}</b></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">🚴 Kilometri</p><b>${km}</b></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">🏋️ Sală</p><b>${sport} min</b></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">🏊 Alte sporturi</p><b>${other} min</b></div></div></div>
  ${(()=>{const sl=keys.map(k=>+(S.days[k]&&S.days[k].sleep)||0).filter(Boolean),en=keys.map(k=>S.days[k]&&S.days[k].energy).filter(Boolean);const avg=a=>a.length?(a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length):0;return `<div class="card"><h3>Somn și energie</h3><div class="tiles" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">😴 Somn mediu</p><b>${sl.length?avg(sl).toFixed(1)+' h':'—'}</b></div><div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">⚡ Energie medie</p><b>${en.length?avg(en).toFixed(1)+' / 5':'—'}</b></div></div></div>`})()}
  <div class="card"><h3>Stări</h3><div class="chips" style="margin-top:10px">${Object.entries(moods).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([m,c])=>`<span class="chip">${m} · ${c}</span>`).join('')||'<p class="hint">Completează rezumatul zilei ca să vezi tendința.</p>'}</div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Scoruri la joc</h3>${S.scores.slice(-6).reverse().map(s=>`<div class="ev"><span class="time">${s.score}/10</span><span class="tt">${LANGS[s.lang].name} · ${LEVELS[s.level]} <span class="muted">· ${s.date}</span></span></div>`).join('')||'<p class="hint" style="margin-top:6px">Niciun joc încă.</p>'}</div></div>`;
}

/* project */
let projMic=null;
function renderProj(){
  const P=S.project;const col=(k,title,hint)=>`<div class="col" data-col="${k}"><p class="eyebrow">${title}</p>${P[k].map((it,i)=>`<div class="item"><span>${esc(it)}</span>${k!=='done'?`<button data-mv="${k}:${i}" title="Mută mai departe">→</button>`:''}<button data-rm="${k}:${i}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></div>`).join('')||`<p class="hint">${hint}</p>`}<div class="row"><input type="text" placeholder="Adaugă…" data-in="${k}" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" data-mic="${k}" aria-label="Adaugă vocal" style="width:40px;height:40px">${MICSVG}</button></div></div>`;
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Proiect</h1><div class="card"><label class="f">Numele proiectului<input type="text" id="pName" value="${esc(P.name)}" placeholder="Ex: Cabinet nou, Carte, Casă"></label></div>
  <div class="kan">${col('ideas','Idei','Scanează ideile aici.')}${col('tasks','De făcut','Task-urile proiectului.')}${col('done','Făcut','Ce ai realizat.')}</div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Visul meu</h3><p class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 10px">Imaginea mare, pe termen lung. Zilnic te întreb ce ai făcut pentru el.</p><textarea id="dream" placeholder="Visul meu este…">${esc(S.dream)}</textarea></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('pName').oninput=e=>{P.name=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('dream').oninput=e=>{S.dream=e.target.value;save()};
  const add=(k,v)=>{v=(v||'').trim();if(!v)return;P[k].push(v);save();renderProj();burst(window.innerWidth/2,window.innerHeight/2)};
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-in]').forEach(i=>i.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')add(i.dataset.in,i.value)});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-mic]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,t=>add(b.dataset.mic,t)));
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-mv]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const [k,i]=b.dataset.mv.split(':');const it=P[k].splice(+i,1)[0];const nk=k==='ideas'?'tasks':'done';P[nk].push(it);if(nk==='done'){chord();toast('Un pas mai aproape de proiect.')}save();renderProj()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-rm]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const [k,i]=b.dataset.rm.split(':');P[k].splice(+i,1);save();renderProj()});
}

/* game */
let G=null;
function makeQuiz(lang,level){const ro=RO[level],tg=LANGS[lang].w[level];const idx=[...ro.keys()].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
  return idx.map(i=>{const wrong=[...tg.keys()].filter(j=>j!==i).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,3);const opts=[i,...wrong].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);return{q:ro[i],a:tg[i],opts:opts.map(j=>tg[j])}})}
function renderGame(){
  if(!G){main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Joc de relaxare</h1><p class="muted">10 întrebări. Alege limba și nivelul.</p>
    <div class="card"><p class="eyebrow">Limba</p><div class="chips" id="gl">${Object.entries(LANGS).map(([k,v],i)=>`<button class="chip" data-v="${k}" aria-pressed="${i===0}">${v.name}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:14px">Nivel</p><div class="chips" id="gv">${Object.entries(LEVELS).map(([k,v])=>`<button class="chip" data-v="${k}" aria-pressed="${k==='1'}">${v}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="gStart">Începe jocul</button></div></div>
    ${S.scores.length?`<div class="card"><p class="eyebrow">Cel mai bun scor</p><span class="big">${Math.max(...S.scores.map(s=>s.score))}/10</span></div>`:''}</div>`;
    const pick=id=>main.querySelector('#'+id+' .chip[aria-pressed="true"]').dataset.v;
    main.querySelectorAll('#gl .chip,#gv .chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{b.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'));b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true')});
    document.getElementById('gStart').onclick=()=>{G={lang:pick('gl'),level:pick('gv'),i:0,score:0,picked:null,qs:makeQuiz(pick('gl'),pick('gv'))};renderGame()};return}
  if(G.i>=10){const sc=G.score;S.scores.push({lang:G.lang,level:G.level,score:sc,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})});save();
    main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>${sc>=9?'Excelent!':sc>=6?'Foarte bine!':'Bun început!'}</h1><div class="card" style="text-align:center"><p class="eyebrow">${LANGS[G.lang].name} · ${LEVELS[G.level]}</p><span class="big" style="font-size:3.4rem">${sc}/10</span><p class="muted" style="margin-top:8px">${'⭐'.repeat(Math.max(1,Math.round(sc/2)))}</p></div><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="again">Încă o rundă</button><button class="btn ghost" id="back">Alt joc</button></div></div>`;
    if(sc>=9)celebrate(sc+'/10. Impecabil.');else if(sc>=6){chord();burst(window.innerWidth/2,200)}
    document.getElementById('again').onclick=()=>{G={...G,i:0,score:0,picked:null,qs:makeQuiz(G.lang,G.level)};renderGame()};document.getElementById('back').onclick=()=>{G=null;renderGame()};return}
  const q=G.qs[G.i];
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><div class="row between"><p class="eyebrow">${LANGS[G.lang].name} · ${LEVELS[G.level]}</p><b>${G.i+1}/10 · ${G.score} pct</b></div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${G.i/10*100}%"></i></div>
    <div class="card"><p class="eyebrow">Cum se spune în ${LANGS[G.lang].name.toLowerCase()}</p><h2 style="font-size:1.9rem;margin-top:6px">„${q.q}”</h2><div style="margin-top:10px">${q.opts.map(o=>`<button class="opt ${G.picked?(o===q.a?'ok':o===G.picked?'bad':''):''}" data-o="${esc(o)}" ${G.picked?'disabled':''}>${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    ${G.picked?`<div style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn" id="next">${G.i===9?'Vezi scorul':'Următoarea'}</button></div>`:''}</div><button class="btn ghost small" id="quit" style="align-self:flex-start">Renunță</button></div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{G.picked=b.dataset.o;if(G.picked===q.a){G.score++;const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left+40,r.top+10);cling()}renderGame()});
  const nx=document.getElementById('next');if(nx)nx.onclick=()=>{G.i++;G.picked=null;renderGame()};
  document.getElementById('quit').onclick=()=>{G=null;renderGame()};
}

/* to-do lists */
let todoTab='personal',newPri='normal';
const PRI={hi:'Urgent',mid:'Important',normal:'Normal'};const PORD={hi:0,mid:1,normal:2};
const todoRow=(t,list)=>`<div class="task" data-done="${t.done?1:0}" data-p="${t.pri||'normal'}" data-tid="${t.id}" data-list="${list}"><button class="box" aria-label="Bifează">${t.done?'✔':''}</button><button class="pri" data-p="${t.pri||'normal'}" data-cyc="${t.id}" aria-label="Schimbă prioritatea" title="${PRI[t.pri||'normal']}"></button><span class="t">${t.pri==='hi'?'<b style="font-size:1.15em">!</b> ':''}${esc(t.text)}</span><span class="tag ${list==='work'?'pro':'pers'}">${list==='work'?'pro':'personal'}</span><button class="del" data-tdel="${t.id}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></div>`;
function bindTodoRows(root,after){
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-tid] .box').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const row=b.closest('.task');const t=S.todos[row.dataset.list].find(x=>x.id===row.dataset.tid);t.done=!t.done;if(t.done){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left+16,r.top+16);if(t.pri==='hi'){chord();toast('Urgența rezolvată.')}else{cling();toast(PRAISE[Math.floor(Math.random()*PRAISE.length)])}const L=S.todos[row.dataset.list];if(L.length>=3&&L.every(x=>x.done))setTimeout(()=>celebrate('Lista închisă. Toate făcute.'),300)}save();after()});
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-cyc]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const row=b.closest('.task');const t=S.todos[row.dataset.list].find(x=>x.id===row.dataset.tid);t.pri=t.pri==='hi'?'normal':t.pri==='mid'?'hi':'mid';save();after()});
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-tdel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const row=b.closest('.task');S.todos[row.dataset.list]=S.todos[row.dataset.list].filter(x=>x.id!==row.dataset.tid);save();after()});
}
function renderTodo(){
  const L=S.todos;const lst=L[todoTab];const sortP=(a,b)=>PORD[a.pri||'normal']-PORD[b.pri||'normal'];const open=lst.filter(t=>!t.done).sort(sortP),closed=lst.filter(t=>t.done);
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Liste</h1><div class="chips"><button class="chip lp" data-t="personal" aria-pressed="${todoTab==='personal'}">Personal · ${L.personal.filter(t=>!t.done).length}</button><button class="chip lw" data-t="work" aria-pressed="${todoTab==='work'}">Profesional · ${L.work.filter(t=>!t.done).length}</button></div>
  <div class="card ${todoTab==='work'?'lw':'lp'}"><div class="row" style="margin-bottom:8px"><input type="text" id="tNew" placeholder="${todoTab==='personal'?'Ex: Programare la coafor':'Ex: Sună furnizorul de implanturi'}" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><button class="mic" id="tMic" aria-label="Adaugă vocal">${MICSVG}</button><button class="btn small" id="tAdd">Adaugă</button></div>
  <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:10px"><span class="hint">Prioritate:</span>${['hi','mid','normal'].map(p=>`<button class="pbtn ${p}" data-np="${p}" aria-pressed="${newPri===p}">${p==='hi'?'! ':''}${PRI[p]}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  ${open.map(t=>todoRow(t,todoTab)).join('')||'<p class="hint">Lista e goală. Adaugă primul task.</p>'}
  ${closed.length?`<p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:14px">Făcute</p>${closed.map(t=>todoRow(t,todoTab)).join('')}<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn ghost small" id="tClear">Curăță făcutele</button></div>`:''}
  <p class="hint" style="margin-top:10px">Apasă bulina colorată ca să schimbi prioritatea: roșu = urgent, portocaliu = important, negru = normal.</p></div></div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{todoTab=b.dataset.t;renderTodo()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-np]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{newPri=b.dataset.np;renderTodo()});
  const add=v=>{v=(v||'').trim();if(!v)return;let pri=newPri;if(/\b(urgent|urgentă|prioritar)\b/i.test(v)){pri='hi'}lst.push({id:uid(),text:v[0].toUpperCase()+v.slice(1),done:false,pri});save();renderTodo();toast('Adăugat')};
  document.getElementById('tAdd').onclick=()=>add(document.getElementById('tNew').value);
  document.getElementById('tNew').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')add(e.target.value)};
  document.getElementById('tMic').onclick=e=>listen(e.currentTarget,add);
  bindTodoRows(main,renderTodo);
  const c=document.getElementById('tClear');if(c)c.onclick=()=>{L[todoTab]=L[todoTab].filter(x=>!x.done);save();renderTodo()};
}
/* more menu */
function renderMore(){main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Mai mult</h1><div class="menu">
  <button data-go="proj">Proiect<span>Idei, task-uri, făcut, visul meu</span></button><button data-go="album">Album foto<span>Fotografiile tale, cu notițe</span></button>
  <button data-go="game">Joc de limbi<span>10 întrebări, 5 limbi</span></button><button data-go="set">Setări<span>Culori, sunet, profil, sincronizare</span></button></div></div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{view=b.dataset.go;render()})}
/* album */
let assetsNS=null;(async()=>{try{if(window.claude&&window.claude.use)assetsNS=await window.claude.use('assets')}catch(e){}})();
function shrink(file,max=1000){return new Promise(res=>{const img=new Image();const u=URL.createObjectURL(file);img.onload=()=>{const sc=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(img.width,img.height));const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.round(img.width*sc);c.height=Math.round(img.height*sc);c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,c.width,c.height);URL.revokeObjectURL(u);c.toBlob(b=>res(b),'image/jpeg',.78)};img.onerror=()=>res(null);img.src=u})}
function renderAlbum(){
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Album foto</h1><div class="card"><p class="hint">Alege fotografii de pe telefon. ${assetsNS?'Se păstrează în contul tău, pe toate dispozitivele.':'Se păstrează pe acest dispozitiv (câteva zeci de poze).'}</p>
  <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><label class="btn" for="phIn">Adaugă fotografii</label><input type="file" id="phIn" accept="image/*" multiple hidden><label class="f" style="flex:1">Notiță<input type="text" id="phCap" placeholder="Ex: Weekend la munte"></label></div></div>
  <div class="album" id="album">${S.photos.slice().reverse().map(p=>`<figure><img src="${p.url||p.src}" alt="${esc(p.caption)}" loading="lazy"><figcaption>${esc(p.caption)||'<span class="muted">'+p.date+'</span>'}</figcaption><button class="rm" data-ph="${p.id}" aria-label="Șterge">×</button></figure>`).join('')||'<p class="hint">Nicio fotografie încă.</p>'}</div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('phIn').onchange=async e=>{const files=[...e.target.files];if(!files.length)return;toast('Se încarcă…');const cap=document.getElementById('phCap').value.trim();
    for(const f of files){const b=await shrink(f);if(!b)continue;let item={id:uid(),caption:cap,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('ro-RO',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'})};
      if(assetsNS){try{const r=await assetsNS.upload(b);item.assetId=r.id;item.url=r.url}catch(err){toast('Nu am putut încărca o fotografie');continue}}
      else{item.src=await new Promise(res=>{const fr=new FileReader();fr.onload=()=>res(fr.result);fr.readAsDataURL(b)})}
      S.photos.push(item)}
    try{save()}catch(err){}renderAlbum();toast('Fotografii adăugate 📷')};
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-ph]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{const p=S.photos.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.ph);if(p&&p.assetId&&assetsNS){try{await assetsNS.delete(p.assetId)}catch(e){}}S.photos=S.photos.filter(x=>x.id!==b.dataset.ph);save();renderAlbum()});
}
/* settings */
function renderSet(){
  const p=S.profile;
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="view"><h1>Setări</h1>
    <div class="card"><h3>Nuanțele tale</h3><p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 10px">Crem + o nuanță deschisă + una foarte închisă. Nimic altceva.</p>${palPicker(S.pal||'lumiere')}</div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Sub salut, în fiecare zi</h3><p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 10px">Ce vrei să citești dimineața.</p>${dailyPicker()}</div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Profil</h3><div class="stack" style="margin-top:10px"><label class="f">Cum să-ți spun<input type="text" id="pn" value="${esc(p.name)}" placeholder="Prenume"></label><p class="hint">${p.g==='f'?'Femeie':'Bărbat'} · ${p.age} · ${p.kids} copii · ${p.pets.dog} câini, ${p.pets.cat} pisici</p><div class="row between"><label class="row" style="font-weight:600"><input type="checkbox" id="snd" ${S.sound?'checked':''}> Sunete la bifă (clopoțel, acord, aplauze la 90%)</label><button class="btn ghost small" id="tsnd">Testează sunetul</button></div><p class="hint">Pe iPhone, dacă butonul lateral e pe silențios (🔕), sunetele aplicației sunt oprite de telefon.</p></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Visul meu</h3><textarea id="dream2" placeholder="Visul meu este…">${esc(S.dream)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Rutina</h3><p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 10px">Readaugă sugestiile potrivite profilului tău.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn ghost small" id="resug">Adaugă sugestiile</button><button class="btn ghost small" id="reset">Șterge tot și reia</button></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Sincronizare</h3><p class="hint" style="margin-top:6px">${sync.status==='ok'?'✓ Datele tale se salvează în contul tău Claude și apar pe orice dispozitiv unde deschizi acest link.':sync.status==='err'?'Sincronizarea nu a reușit acum; datele rămân salvate pe acest dispozitiv și se vor trimite la următoarea deschidere.':'Datele se păstrează doar pe acest dispozitiv (deschide link-ul din contul tău Claude pentru sincronizare).'}</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Microfon</h3><p class="hint" style="margin-top:6px">Fereastra Claude blochează microfonul pentru toate aplicațiile. Dictarea funcționează când deschizi fișierul <b>noot.html</b> direct în Chrome sau Safari (și după instalarea pe ecranul principal din acel browser).</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Instalează pe telefon</h3><div class="stack" style="margin-top:8px"><p class="hint"><b>iPhone:</b> deschide link-ul în Safari → butonul Partajare → „Adaugă pe ecranul principal”.</p><p class="hint"><b>Android:</b> deschide link-ul în Chrome → meniul ⋮ → „Adaugă pe ecranul de pornire”.</p><p class="hint">Apoi Noot se deschide ca o aplicație, pe tot ecranul.</p></div></div></div>`;
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-pal]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.pal=b.dataset.pal;save();render()});
  main.querySelectorAll('[data-qt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.quoteTone=b.dataset.qt;save();renderSet()});
  document.getElementById('pn').oninput=e=>{p.name=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('snd').onchange=e=>{S.sound=e.target.checked;save()};document.getElementById('tsnd').onclick=e=>{const r=e.target.getBoundingClientRect();burst(r.left,r.top);cling();setTimeout(chord,500);setTimeout(()=>celebrate('Și așa sună o zi stăpânită.'),1300)};
  document.getElementById('dream2').oninput=e=>{S.dream=e.target.value;save()};
  document.getElementById('resug').onclick=()=>{const have=new Set(S.routine.map(r=>r.text));[...SUG[p.g],...extraSug(p)].forEach(([text,when,cat])=>{if(!have.has(text))S.routine.push({id:uid(),text,when,cat})});save();toast('Sugestii adăugate');view='day';render()};
  document.getElementById('reset').onclick=()=>{S=defaults();ob={step:0,g:null,age:null,rel:null,kids:0,kidStage:[],pets:{dog:0,cat:0}};save();render()};
}
render();
</script>

</body>
</html>
